source_of_truth.statement: THIS CONTRACT IS NOT A PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION. VCF Automation ships no machine-readable API specification: it is absent from the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0), which covers other VCF components only. Every operation, field name, cardinality and enum value below was hand-derived on 2026-08-11 by reading the Broadcom xAPIs reference documentation pages recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Treat this file as a faithful transcription of human-readable reference docs, not as a normative schema. Where the reference is silent, ambiguous or self-contradictory, the gap is recorded explicitly in the 'reference_gaps' section rather than being filled in by guesswork.

servers.note: The reference renders all paths against a placeholder host, written as https://{api_host}/... in its curl samples. The paths below are absolute and host-independent.

authentication.note: The token operation itself does NOT use this scheme. It uses HTTP Basic client authentication; see operation 'issueAccessToken'.

versioning.statement: The reference documents NO API version negotiation for these services. There is no apiVersion query parameter on any Catalog or Deployment operation, and no versioned media type. Requests and responses are plain application/json. Do not send an Accept header of the form 'application/json;version=9.1.0' on these operations: that convention belongs to the Provider Infrastructure (vCloud-lineage) APIs, which are a different service, and it is not documented for the VM Apps Org Catalog or Deployment services. The portal pins 9.1 through the documentation URL only; fetching the operation page under the explicit '9.1' path segment returns content identical to 'latest'.

wire_conventions.json_optional_fields: An optional field whose value is not set MUST be omitted from the request body entirely. It must NOT be sent as null, as an empty string, or as an empty object. The reference annotates optional fields purely by their absence from the required list; it never documents a null sentinel for any of them.
wire_conventions.form_optional_fields: The same rule applies to application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies: an unset optional parameter MUST NOT appear in the encoded body at all. It must not be emitted as 'name=' with an empty value.
wire_conventions.query_optional_params: Unset optional query parameters MUST be omitted from the query string rather than sent with an empty value.

operations.summary: Get Access Token Pkce Flow. Exchanges an authorization_code or refresh_token grant for an access token.

deprecated.note: The reference marks every token-issuing operation it documents as deprecated in favour of /oidc/oauth2/token, but publishes NO detail page for that successor, so the successor's wire shape cannot be derived from the reference. This contract therefore models the deprecated operation, which is the only refresh-capable token operation in the reference with a complete, unambiguous wire shape. This is a deliberate, recorded choice, not an oversight.

Authorization.note: Documented verbatim as 'Basic Base64_Encode(client_id:client_secret)'. Public OAuth clients use 'Basic Base64_Encode(client_id:)' with an empty client_secret. Because the client is authenticated by this header, the optional client_id form field is redundant and must be omitted.

org_id.note: snake_case on this operation. The sibling /csp/gateway/am/api/login/oauth operation spells the same concept orgId. Do not normalise one to the other.

client_id.note: Ignored when the Authorization header is set.

expires_in.note: Access token expiration. The reference does not state the unit; VCF Automation bearer access tokens are documented elsewhere as one-hour expiring.

status_codes.400: Invalid request body or authorization header.
status_codes.404: Organization with this identifier is not found.

operations.summary: Fetch a list of catalog items.

size.description: The size of the page to be returned.

sort.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).

search.description: Matches will have this string somewhere in their name or description.

projects.description: A list of project IDs. Results will belong to one of these projects.

types.description: A list of Catalog Item Type IDs. Results will be one of these types.

expandProjects.description: Whether or not to return detailed project data for each result.

expand.description: The expanded details of the requested comma separated objects.

$skip.description: Number of records you want to skip.

$orderby.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property (asc|desc).

request.query_parameters_note: This is the COMPLETE set of 11 documented query parameters. There is no expandVersions parameter and no singular projectId parameter on this operation; the project filter is the plural array 'projects'. Catalog item versions are a separate operation.

request.fields_note: The reference annotates EVERY field of this body as optional, including projectId and deploymentName. That is a weakness of the published annotation, not a statement that the fields are dispensable: a deployment request without projectId and deploymentName is not useful. Read 'required: false' here as 'not annotated required by the reference'. It does NOT license sending a field with a null or empty value; see wire_conventions.json_optional_fields. There is no deploymentId field in this request body.

response.cardinality_note: The response is an ARRAY of objects, not a single object, because bulkRequestCount may produce several deployments from one request.
response.fields_note: These two fields are the entire documented response. catalogItemId, version and requestId are NOT response fields. In particular the request id is not returned here, so the id needed to poll progress must be obtained separately via listDeploymentRequests.

operations.summary: Get Deployment Requests. Returns the requests raised against one deployment.

request.query_parameters_note: This operation documents no $filter parameter, unlike GET /deployment/api/deployments.

response.item_fields_note: Each element of content has the same shape as the getRequest response.

operations.summary: Get Request. Returns the current state of one deployment request.

request.query_parameters_note: No query parameters are documented for this operation.

response.progress_note: Progress is reported as completedTasks and totalTasks. There is no 'progress', 'completed' or 'total' field.

RequestStatus.terminal_values_note: The reference publishes the enum but does not classify its members as terminal or non-terminal. The terminal_values list above is this contract's reading of the state machine: a request that has succeeded, failed, been aborted, or had its approval rejected will not change state again. It is recorded here as a derived judgement, not as documented fact.
RequestStatus.note: This enum belongs to the request resource. The lastRequestStatus filter on GET /deployment/api/deployments accepts only a 7-value subset (ABORTED, APPROVAL_PENDING, APPROVAL_REJECTED, FAILED, INPROGRESS, PENDING, SUCCESSFUL). The two lists are not interchangeable.

reference_gaps.gap: /oidc/oauth2/token is named as the replacement for every documented token operation, but has no detail page in the reference. Its request and response shapes are unknown from this source.

Both the Catalog and Deployment operations list 401 as a documented status code, but neither publishes an error body schema or description for it, and no WWW-Authenticate behaviour is documented. Nothing in the reference describes how an expired access token is signalled beyond the bare status code. Consumers should therefore key expiry handling on the 401 status code alone and must not depend on any particular error body shape.

That page's prose says application/x-www-form-urlencoded while its schema block and generated curl sample both say application/json. The contradiction is unresolved in the reference. This contract avoids the operation for that reason.

The 'pageable' and 'sort' sub-objects of the paged envelopes are named but not expanded on the Deployment operation pages. The Catalog page expands them as pageable{offset, pageNumber, pageSize, paged, sort, unpaged} and sort{empty, sorted, unsorted}; whether the Deployment service matches is not documented.
expires_in is typed as int64 but the reference does not state its unit.
